purpose: Report evidence; historical records, no new training run

model.scope: single-egress transfer plus mapped local compute; not full SFL round, accuracy or deployment

assumptions.label: KOREN/Jetson measurement-conditioned replay; not a new field measurement
notes: One measured Jetson is replicated into eight logical timing profiles; these are not eight measured boards.
The measured Qwen full step is partitioned by an assumed tail fraction. No Jetson SFL backward-only measurement exists in these inputs.
The 4.2 MB payload comes from the KOREN echo workload, not from a measured Qwen split activation.
The network rate is an effective aggregate round-trip payload service parameter derived from common wall intervals, not physical one-way link capacity.
The 0.1 capacity factor is a synthetic sensitivity case; compute/payload are unchanged and no 32-to-8 equivalence is asserted.
Network window 0 and Jetson steps 0-9 calibrate the policy; windows 1-2 and steps 10-29 evaluate it.

definitions.federation_scoring: saved strict overrides applied to all 18 heldout question forms
definitions.memory: archived peak_rss_mb divided by 1000 for plotted GB; front profile, not whole system
definitions.koren: 3 seed means; first 4 rounds excluded; multiple controls changed
definitions.lora_transport: activation and labels sent; gradients returned; no privacy guarantee
definitions.vertical_wording: model layer partitioning plus federation; not feature-partitioned VFL
